issue: simplify() drops assumptions on Symbol when the expression is rebuilt, so positive=True is lost after simplification. Preserve symbol assumptions through the rebuild.

dependencyMemories.body: Symbol assumptions are stored on the Symbol object and are lost if you reconstruct via Symbol(name); use symbol.func(*symbol.args, **symbol.assumptions0) to preserve them through a rebuild.

distractorMemories.body: Matrix determinant uses Bareiss by default; switch to LU for large dense matrices.
